title: Change claimed with our key and path, paid to someone else

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: The second output carries our public key and change path in its PSBT metadata, but its script pays a foreign key. A signer that trusts the metadata hides a 0.0039 BTC payment to the attacker as change.
rule: Rebuild the output script from the seed at the claimed path and count the output as a spend unless it matches.
